name: WayriCAD Portable Web Export
description: Export a KiCad project as one offline interactive HTML review and assembly page.
description_full: Build one self-contained HTML document from selected schematic sheets, PCB layout, BoM data and supported 3D models. The export uses the maintained KiCad WebView renderer, works directly from disk without a server or CDN, cross-selects saved component identities, and keeps procurement and assembly progress in revision-scoped browser storage with JSON backup and recovery. A native preflight window lists missing or unsupported assets and estimates the final file size before writing.
